The assistant built a queueing model: actions arrive, one in ten objectionable; the overseer detects each after a random delay, evaluates it with four reviewers first come first served, and an objection suspends; the time to irreversibility has mean 30 days divided by the speed factor. In the fast arm, limits brought back the share of the gap they covered (0.25 to 1.0) keeping 0.92 to 0.99 of the speed's benefit; suspension brought back at most 0.54, the share detected before irreversibility, keeping 0.91 to 0.99; pauses brought back 0.49 for a loss of a third of the benefit and all of it only by giving up all the benefit, and under the volume reading nothing at all. The model and its rates are the assistant's and invented, so it shows what holds in the model, not in any institution. The wording is the assistant's (Claude, in this session); adopting it is the owner's call. | Proposed |

Where the base budget alone sustains competence 0.25, below the commitment threshold, the coupled rule has an absorbing state, never committed and never funded, and over thirty years, under A's rule as written, reaches it in every run at one occasion in two and a half years or rarer, in 93 % at one a year, in 39 % at four a year and in under 1 % at sixteen. Funding maintenance apart from activity, at what full use would earn, never loses it at any rarity. Without the coverage feedback there is no absorbing state, though lumpy budgets still sustain less competence the rarer the use. Where the base alone sustains competence above the threshold, nothing is lost for good, but at the rarest occasions the coupled rule meets a quarter of them against nearly all under decoupling. The model is the assistant's and its rates are invented. The wording is the assistant's (Claude, in this session); adopting it is the owner's call. | Active |
